candidate_loss_controls.missing_or_corrupt_deliverable: Related record/protected scores decrease, no evaluation error
candidate_loss_controls.missing_claim_field_mapping: Its fixed public claim slots fail
candidate_loss_controls.protected_input_mutation: protected_delivery=0; all other identical scores preserved

semantic_boundary_controls.real_date_wrong_event_relation: Mechanical token/date can pass; factual_support/coverage must be checked by actual Judge
semantic_boundary_controls.publication_in_window_old_event: Publication date existence does not prove event occurrence; actual Judge rejects old event counting
semantic_boundary_controls.future_launch_promoted_to_GA: Mechanical citations can pass; actual Judge rejects stage inflation
semantic_boundary_controls.same_change_multi_stage: Distinct candidate IDs do not prove distinct groups; actual Judge checks duplication
semantic_boundary_controls.model_only_or_non_search_release: Files/citations do not prove AI-search product scope; actual Judge checks
semantic_boundary_controls.syndicated_many_domains: Domain count not independent evidence; actual Judge checks lineage and honest single-source disclosure
semantic_boundary_controls.unsupported_trend_or_action: IDs and source quote location may pass; actual Judge checks actual premise/support/bounds

control_evidence_policy: Synthetic no-answer parser tests establish mechanics only. Full artifact/bundle controls require independently collected production sources. Preserve failed rounds, exact errors/assertions and same-round code/contract hashes. Never invent semantic scores.
